notes.title: A message from Dev Team
notes.content:
[p align="start"]Hello everyone,
We are Dev team of Microvolts: Recharged.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]On August 26, we rolled out a major update to the weapon system.[/p][p align="start"]Since then, we’ve carefully reviewed the many pieces of feedback you’ve shared. While our hope was that this update would serve as a refreshing step forward, we realize that the intentions behind these changes may not have been[/p][p align="start"]clearly conveyed. For that reason, we wanted to break our silence and provide a more detailed explanation of the decisions we made and the direction we’re aiming for.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]We hope that through this note, our intentions and long-term vision become clearer.[/p][p align="start"]
======================================[/p][p align="start"]
[b]1. Why we reworked the combat mechanics[/b][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]At the beginning of the game, we tried to maintain a traditional FPS-style combat system. However, this approach limited the unique weapon concepts that define Microvolts. We came to the conclusion that the previous system was not aligned with the game’s core identity.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]With this update, our goal has been to highlight the individuality of each weapon concept and allow players to experience a wider range of playstyles. Moving forward, we want combat to be more than just numbers on weapon stats. We want every weapon to bring unique effects, distinctive traits, and tactical possibilities, giving you the freedom to tune and strategize in your own way.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]2. Weapon types and concepts[/b][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]This update brings a big change to how each weapon type works. Our goal was to make the traits of each type clearer, so that players can choose weapons that match their preferred style.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Melee[/b] weapons give players the freedom to personalize their combat style, supported by core movement abilities.
● Mobility Type: High agility allows you to approach enemies quickly and excel in ambushes.
- Movement speed has enhanced than before  
● Range Type: Balanced performance and extended reach provide stable combat.
- Movement speed has slightly enhanced[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Rifles[/b] provide balanced capabilities for mid and short-range encounters, supporting multiple tactical choices.
● Precision Type: Zoom feature gives an advantage at mid-to-long range and supports team battles.
- Zoom performance is enhanced
● Rapid-Fire Type: Optimized for close combat with a fast rate of fire to continuously pressure enemies.
- Fire rate and reloading speed are enhanced.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Shotguns[/b] focus on fast, decisive strikes in close-range encounters, allowing players to control combat flow. 
● Auto Type: High fire rate for overwhelming opponents in close quarters.
- Reloading speed has been enhanced.
● Double-Tap Type: Delivers burst damage with two quick shots, excelling at suppression.
- Knockback effect has been enhanced.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Snipers[/b] are designed for dominance at long distances, giving players flexibility to fit their preferred approach.
● Auto Type: Prioritizes sustained output, enabling you to land consistent follow-up shots in mid-range duels with faster reload speed. 
● Zoom-Speed Type: High magnification and quick zoom for accurate long-range shots.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Gatlings[/b] shine in close-quarters chaos, giving players an edge against groups of enemies.
● Rapid-Fire Type: Provides consistent fast firing, quickly taking down enemies and excelling in close-range battles.
- Fire rate and spin-up speed have been enhanced. 
● Power Type: Offers strong attack power that can suppress foes and shift the battle rapidly.
- Damage and enemy knockback have been enhanced.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Bazookas[/b] are designed for controlled explosive impact, Bazookas expand tactical possibilities in mid- and long-range encounters.
● Burst Type: Focused on quick fire and successive hits, this type offers high efficiency in close and mid-range encounters.
- Fire rate and reloading speed have been enhanced.
● High-Speed Type: Features fast projectile speed and delivers solid performance with balanced mechanics.
- Missile speed and effective range have been enhanced.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Grenades[/b] enhance battlefield strategy by creating dynamic and flexible combat scenarios.
● Direct-Impact Type: Explodes immediately on impact, specializing in fast firing and rapid response in combat.
- As explosion mechanics have been modified, both fire rate and reload speed have increased.
● Sticky Type: Attaches to surfaces and functions like a mine, offering strong power and wide tactical options.
- As explosion mechanics have been modified, its damage has increased.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]3. Looking ahead[/b][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Our future plans for MVR include expanding weapon customization and introducing more tuning variations so that every player can express their preferred combat style. We are also planning additional cosmetic options—such as glow effects, which many of you have requested—to provide a sense of visual satisfaction alongside gameplay improvements.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Most importantly, we want to emphasize that our focus is not only on balance numbers, but also on your actual play experiences. Your feedback will continue to guide us as we refine and improve the game.[/p][p align="start"]
======================================[/p][p align="start"]
We remain committed to building a game that you can enjoy through your feedback and participation.
Thank you for supporting Microvolts: Recharged.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Sincerely,
Microvolts: Recharged Development Team[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]※ p.s We are aware of the currently reported issues and are working to address them as quickly as possible. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.[/p]

notes.title: Get ready for the upcoming LIMITED CAPSULE!
notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42841026/498e02d9b51b6e1d7f9bb4b76c00e2d1244e429f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: CLAN BATTLE EVENT Season 3 : Result and Rewards
notes.content:
CASUAL TPS 『MICROVOLTS : Recharged』
Battle with your own figure!

Hello players,
This is MVR Team.

Our CLAN BATTLE EVENT Season 3 has successfully ended with a lot of interest from players.
Before announcing the results, we identified players who engaged in abnormal gameplay. Appropriate actions have been taken, and these players have been excluded from receiving rewards.

Finally, we are excited to announce you the winner of the tournament!

[h3][b]🎉 WINNER : YaYaProduction🎉 [/b][/h3]

Please give a big round of applause to the winning team, who took the victory after a very intense battle.
Next, we will announce the second and third place clans.

[h3][b]2nd Place : Strategy
3rd Place : Apex[/b][/h3]

We would like to thank all the participants for their contributions.
The full tournament video is uploaded on the official Masangsoft YouTube channel.

notes.title: [Tournament] Clan Battle Event Season 3
notes.content:
CASUAL TPS 『MICROVOLTS : Recharged』
Battle with your own figure! 

Hello players,

We are thrilled to announce the start of recruitment for Clan Battle Event Season 3!
We prepared approximately $1,800 worth of RT prizes for this event, and we encourage all clan members to come and show off their skills!

For this Clan Battle Event, tournament applications and matches will be managed through [b]“Triumph”[/b], the e-sports tournament platform operated by Masangsoft.

United power, strategy, and victory! Prove your clan is the best!

==========================================================================
[b]1) Rewards:

- 1st Place: Exclusive 1st Place Clan Mark & CLAN BATTLE Gold Medal + 100,000 RT
- 2nd Place: Exclusive 2nd Place Clan Mark & CLAN BATTLE Silver Medal + 50,000 RT
- 3rd Place: Exclusive 3rd Place Clan Mark & CLAN BATTLE Bronze Medal + 25,000 RT

- All Participants: Limited Capsule Coupon Pack (10) per person[/b]

[i]※  Exclusive clan marks and CLAN BATTLE Medals will be maintained until the start of the next Clan Battle.[/i]

[b]2) Application Period: March 4, 2025 - March 16, 2025[/b]

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1q4KKIaVQ-_feTdnmGSTtwXeRaGYSqpGwAhvqtQ3Vlwc/edit?usp=sharing][b][MICROVOLTS: Recharged] Clan Battle Event Rules[/b][/url]

Please check the Clan Battle Event Rules and then apply through Triumph.

[b]3) How to apply :[/b]

[b]1. Team Leader[/b]
a) Create a Team (Use the same clan mark and clan name as in-game for the team)
b) Set up game profile (Use your in-game nickname)
c) Share the team invitation link with your team members. Once your team is complete, proceed to the tournament registration page.
d) Click the "APPLY" button and select the members to register for the entry.
e) Click "Check-in" to complete team registration.
[i]※ If your team has 4 members, you can add a Dummy to apply
※ Please add the Dummy name as N/A[/i]

[b]2. Team Member[/b]
a) Join the team through the team invitation link shared by the team leader.
b) Set up game profile (Use your in-game nickname)

[b][url=https://tp.masanggames.com/guide/participant]Triumph Guide Link[/url]
[url=https://tp.masanggames.com/Qvyq5aY4EJ]Tournament Application Link[/url][/b]

[b]4) Announcement for Bracket Table : March 18, 2025

5) Match Schedule : To be announced[/b]
==========================================================================

[i]※ Precautions for Clan Battle Event

1. Only one team per clan can participate, and only the team leader can apply. If it is found that the same clan or the same nickname has applied multiple times, they may be excluded from selection.

2. Clan Battle Event applications are only accepted during the registration period.

3.  Rewards will only be given to the entry members of clans whose participation is confirmed after the application is completed.

-  How RT rewards get distributed: RT amount will be evenly distributed among the number of members registered in the entry
- CLAN BATTLE Medal : All players registered in the entry of the ranking-achieving clan
- Participant rewards: All players registered in the entry of clans who have participated in at least one match

4. To be eligible for rewards, please ensure your in-game nickname matches the one you provided on your application from March 5, 2025, until after rewards are distributed following the conclusion of the Clan Battle Event.

5. If the number of applicants exceeds the number of clans that can participate, the participating clans will be selected according to the ‘Clan Ranking’.

6. The event details are subject to change without notice.[/i]

notes.title: Here comes the new event mode, !
notes.content:
CASUAL TPS 『MICROVOLTS : Recharged』
Battle with your own figure!

Hello players,

We know you’ve been eagerly awaiting the next update, and the wait is almost over! 
As announced in the newsletter, the new event mode <Psychic Heroes>, will be on live very soon.

Get ready to defeat your opponents with random abilities and weapons given upon respawn!
[b]<Psychic Heroes>[/b] will offer a more thrilling, strategic, and challenging experience than any battle you’ve played before, bringing you an exciting new challenge and tons of fun.

[b]Event mode will be available from the maintenance on December 24, 2024 to January 14, 2025![/b]
===================================================================
[h3][b][Psychic Heroes Mode Rules][/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42841026/c88b432562333872f9e3af6d0593687a019aa399.png[/img]

1. A player who reaches the target kill count first within the set time wins!

2. One psychic ability & one random weapon(including melee) will be given every time a player respawns.

[b]Psychic ability list:[/b]
• Heal 200 health per second
• +2,560 max health increase (based on the parts in use)
• +200 speed, double jump enabled for all weapon
• Gain +100 max health (up to +1000) and +20 movement speed (up to +200) per kill
• Regenerate +2 ammo per second (for the weapon held)
• +450 damage
• Spawn with berserk item: Immediately restore full health after usage, +200 speed, +1000 damage for 10 seconds
(Press “F” key to use)

3. For every 15 kills without dying, you will receive an additional random psychic ability and random ranged weapon.
※ No duplicate abilities or weapons will be given, and they will be instantly acquired without swapping weapons.

4. Defeating an enemy using a melee weapon will subtract 1 from their kill count.

5. When the remaining time is 3 minutes or less, all players' respawn time will be reduced to 1 second, and movement speed will increase by +200.
※ Health increases and movement speed are stackable

===================================================================
Plus, you'll have a better chance of collecting Christmas tree decorations in this mode!
Have fun and gather amazing rewards from the Winter Wonderland Festival.

Best regards,
MVR Team

We have prepared rewards worth approximately $2,500 in RT as prizes for this event, and we invite all clan members to proudly showcase their skills.

notes.title: Removing XP obtained abnormally
notes.content:
Hello, 

 

This is the MICROVOLTS team.

 

We've completed an investigation into a large number of users who were receiving anomalous experience.
We have taken action to reverse all abnormal experience earned more than 10 times.


We have permanently banned the accounts that were reported as hacktivists
Users who participated in the use of hacking programs have had their unauthorized experience removed.


We've only taken back the abnormally earned experience, but not the current level.
Due to the loss of experience, you will need a lot of experience to level up to the next level.

 

Please be aware of this.

Along with experience, kill/death/assist/win/tie/loss data was also reset.

notes.title: 2023 Microvolts Moderators Recruitment
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42841026/04f059cb1207478fcb168bf313cbaf09e7cae41e.jpg[/img]

Greetings, everyone!

We're recruiting community MODs for our official Forum and Discord server.
If you are knowledgeable about the game, love talking with your fellow, and are good with conflict resolution, join our moderator team.

[b]Open Positions[/b]
[list]
[*] Official Forum Moderator
[*] Discord Moderator
[/list]

[b]Moderator Role[/b]

Create a healthy environment for the game through communication between users and administrators. Moderators send out important information to other players on Discord / Forum and let us know of any issues to help us resolve them as quickly as possible.


[b]Moderator Reward[/b]
A moderator is given monthly rewards from Microvolts team for their service

[list]
[*] In-game RT (about $300) for the first month / RT (about $100) following months 
[*] DIscord ‘Nitro’ (30 days) → only for discord mod
[/list]
※ Based on the current service environment, the content of the monthly reward is subject to change.


[b]Moderator Application process[/b]
1. Check about Our Microvolts mod recruitment announcement.
2. Respond to this form: [[url=https://forms.gle/t3fgKVxgN46g4CZt8]LINK[/url]]
3. Accepted applicants will be messaged via Email or Discord DM.
4. Second interview with applicants (Email)
5. After the interview, if the applicant’s qualities have been acknowledged as exceptional, the [Moderator] role will be given. 
 
※ This application process may close at any time once the required number of Moderators has been met.


[b]Notice[/b]
- The Discord/Forum Moderator role and a portion of Moderator rewards may be revoked in case of Moderator inactivity.
If an event is to occur that prevents regular Moderator activity, Microvolts admin will contact the individual before initiating the above actions. 

- Discord/Forum Moderator must follow the [[url=https://www.masanggames.com/AR_POLICY02]General Rules[/url]].
Violation of a general rule may lead to the immediate removal of the Moderator role and a portion of Moderator rewards.

- Discord/Forum Moderator does not hold any special privilege or authority.
While a Moderator is given the ability to manage certain functions that are designed to maintain a healthy environment for all users, a Moderator fundamentally does not possess any authority over other players  nor do they represent the official voice of Microvolts Recharged.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thank you to all the players who have shown a lot of interest and support.
The first round of recruitment has been completed, and the second interviews has begun.

Personal emails will be sent to the selected candidates, and we’ll inform you once the final selection has been completed.

When a moderator position becomes vacant or when the term expires, we will be recruiting again.

Thank you once again to everyone who has applied.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Moderator recruitment has been confirmed, and we'll inform you through an official moderator announcement soon.

Thank you to everyone :)

notes.title: Sign up for MVR Closed Beta 3.0!
notes.content:
Dearest MVR fans,
 
[b]Starting from the beginning of  Closed Beta 3.0 on 
July 21 at 06:00 UTC - August 6 on Steam, 
you will have access to the game every Friday to Sunday. 
(15:00 GMT+9 / 10:00 GMT+4 / 08:00 CEST / 23:00 PDT / 02:00 EDT)[/b]
 
Please keep in mind the deadline may be extended depending on what our testing needs are at that time.
 
Registration for Closed Beta 3.0 is available from July 3, @02:00 to July 19, @23:59 2023, UTC. 
If you haven’t registered for the past CBT yet, don’t miss the opportunity to join our  Closed Beta 3.0!
[b]Apply for Closed Beta 3.0 on our official website![/b]

Beta keys will be sent out via email to a group of selected players a day before the beta goes live.
Additionally, former beta testers can access  Closed Beta 3.0 without having to register again.

Check out the answers to some of your burning questions!
If you have any further questions, please submit a request through our support page.

                                                                              
[h2]FAQ[/h2]


[b]Q. How can I take part in MICROVOLTS: Recharged Closed beta 3.0?[/b]
Visit our official website in order to apply for the beta test. 
Please make sure that applying does not guarantee that you will gain access to the Closed beta. 
 
[b]Q. I have already registered for the previous beta test. Do I have to register again?[/b]
If you didn’t receive a beta key, then yes. Don't miss the opportunity to register for  Closed Beta 3.0. 
But players who have already participated in previous CBT can still access the game without a beta key.
 
[b]Q. I had access to the previous Beta, would I automatically enter the upcoming beta as well? [/b]
Yes, beta testers who took part in the last beta will get access to the upcoming beta.
To ensure a clean outcome of the new improvements, we wiped off the previous beta's play data.
This means that starting with the upcoming  Closed Beta 3.0, all testers will have to choose an in-game name.
 
[b]Q. How will I know if I have successfully registered?[/b]
When you finish the registration, you will see a message on the web page that says, 
"You've successfully registered."
This notification confirms that you have successfully registered.
 
[b]Q. How are the participants selected?[/b]
There are several elements that will be examined, including (but not limited to), completeness of registration information, the honesty of registration information, and your luck.
 
[b]Q. How will I know if I’m selected to participate in the beta? [/b]
Players who are selected through our web opt-in process will receive an invite through email.
Invites will always be delivered to the email address you’ve used to register for the beta. 
In order to avoid the invitation email from ending up in your junk/spam folder,
please add the sender of the verification email you received from us (noreply@masangsoft.com)
to your contacts (if you received such an email). Additionally, please mark that email as "Non-Spam."

Please note that the Microvolts team will not ask you for any private or personal information.
Do not believe any rumors from third parties, which may result in you being cheated or scammed.
 
[b]Q. Will my data be deleted after the Closed Beta?[/b]
Yes. Your data and game progress will be deleted at the end of  Closed Beta 3.0.
 
[b]Q. Will the Closed Beta 3.0 have any monetized features?[/b]
 Closed Beta 3.0 will not test any monetized content or features.

[b]Q. If I have been invited to participate in this test, may I stream or create any MICROVOLTS: Recharged-related content?[/b]
Please, do😍 There is no Confidentiality Agreement associated with Closed Beta 3.0. GLHF!
